info.title: Intuitive Fusion Procurement Portal API (POC)
info.description: REST API for the POC. Auth is mock (HttpOnly session cookie) behind an IdentityProvider interface. All mutations emit audit events. Errors follow RFC 7807 (application/problem+json) with stable `code` and `correlationId`.

get.description: A requester sees only their own plans

put.summary: Set a plan's own limit (looser than the organisation's only within the allowed relaxation, with a reason and an approver note), reset it, or enter a forecast. Changing the limit or forecast withdraws an exception. Audited
put.description: 422 ESG_OVERRIDE_NEEDS_REASON or ESG_OVERRIDE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS; 423 once the plan is locked; the path key is the metric key

post.summary: Procurement records why a metric in breach should go ahead; the delegates are told
post.description: 409 NOT_IN_BREACH; 423 once the plan is locked

post.summary: A delegate acknowledges the exception; with every breach acknowledged the ESG ceilings gate is satisfied and the plan moves on. Not the person who raised the request
post.description: 409 NO_EXCEPTION or ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED; 403 SOD_VIOLATION

post.summary: Use the lowest-priced submitted bid's declared ESG data as the starting forecast for each metric (indicative only; the awarded contract replaces it)
post.description: 409 NO_BIDS when there are no submitted bids or the contract is already awarded

get.summary: The organisation's usage plan and limits (requests per minute and burst, daily requests, monthly AI calls, storage, users) with today's requests and refused requests, the month's AI calls and the last week
get.description: Counts are batched and written first when this is read

get.summary: Platform operator: every tenant with its plan, active users and today's use, and the available usage plans
get.description: Public as far as sessions go: no cookie and no CSRF token. The only credential is the X-Operator-Token header, compared in constant time with the OPERATOR_TOKEN setting (at least 24 characters). When OPERATOR_TOKEN is not set these endpoints do not exist (404). Limited per client address. 401 OPERATOR_TOKEN_INVALID for a missing or wrong token

post.summary: Platform operator: create a tenant with its short name, a first ADMIN user and a usage plan. The first administrator's one-time password is in the response once; only its hash is kept
post.description: Public as far as sessions go: no cookie and no CSRF token. The only credential is the X-Operator-Token header, compared in constant time with the OPERATOR_TOKEN setting (at least 24 characters). When OPERATOR_TOKEN is not set these endpoints do not exist (404). Limited per client address. 401 OPERATOR_TOKEN_INVALID for a missing or wrong token; 409 TENANT_EXISTS; 422 UNKNOWN_PLAN

patch.summary: Platform operator: move a tenant to another usage plan; the new limits apply to the next request and the change is audited in the tenant's log
patch.description: Public as far as sessions go: no cookie and no CSRF token. The only credential is the X-Operator-Token header, compared in constant time with the OPERATOR_TOKEN setting (at least 24 characters). When OPERATOR_TOKEN is not set these endpoints do not exist (404). Limited per client address. 401 OPERATOR_TOKEN_INVALID for a missing or wrong token; 404 unknown tenant; 422 UNKNOWN_PLAN (also for a plan made for another tenant)

alertsDue.description: Null for roles outside contract management and oversight
